newsitem.title: FRANCE: France invites offers for Cr Lyonnais.
newsitem.headline: France invites offers for Cr Lyonnais.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Wednesday it was open to offers from investors to acquire a stake in ailing state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais.
"As of now, the government is ready to consider any proposals from investors for a minority or a majority stake," it said in a statement.
The statement was issued after a news conference at which Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said he hoped to privatise the bank "as soon as possible".
It came the day the European Commission in Brussels approved an French government emergency aid package of 3.9 billion francs.

Arthuis also announced that the government was drawing up a third, wider rescue plan which would pave the way for the bank to be privatised. Credit Lyonnais is still struggling despite two sucessive state rescue packages in 1994 and 1995.
